WITH library AS ( SELECT uc.id, uc.course_id, uc.create_time, c.name, c.description, c.cover_image, c.content_key, c.content_source FROM user_course uc JOIN course c ON c.id=uc.course_id WHERE uc.user_id=#{userId} AND c.status=1 AND c.deleted=0 AND uc.course_id=#{courseId} AND (c.name LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!' OR c.description LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!') ), facts AS (
), activity AS ( SELECT course_id, occurred_time FROM facts UNION ALL SELECT l.course_id, e.occurred_time FROM course_learning_event e JOIN library l ON l.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.user_id=#{userId} AND e.occurred_time >= l.create_time ), due AS ( SELECT q.course_id, COUNT(*) count_value FROM question_review_schedule s JOIN question q ON q.id=s.question_id JOIN library l ON l.course_id=q.course_id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.deleted=0 AND s.next_review_date <= #{today} AND q.deleted=0 AND (q.visibility='PUBLIC' OR (q.visibility='PRIVATE' AND q.owner_user_id=#{userId})) AND q.id IN (${automaticallyGradableQuestionIds}) GROUP BY q.course_id ), stats AS (SELECT course_id, MAX(occurred_time) last_learning_time FROM activity GROUP BY course_id) SELECT l.id, l.course_id, l.name AS course_name, l.description, l.cover_image, l.content_key, l.content_source, l.create_time AS added_at FROM library l LEFT JOIN stats s ON s.course_id=l.course_id LEFT JOIN due d ON d.course_id=l.course_id WHERE (#{learningStatus} IS NULL OR #{learningStatus}='' OR (#{learningStatus}='STARTED' AND s.last_learning_time IS NOT NULL) OR (#{learningStatus}='NOT_STARTED' AND s.last_learning_time IS NULL) OR (#{learningStatus}='DUE_REVIEW' AND COALESCE(d.count_value,0)>0))
ORDER BY s.last_learning_time DESC, l.create_time DESC, l.id DESC
ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.id DESC
